description_more: Question asked: "Did you drink any coffee yesterday?" If the participant activated the Help feature they were shown the message:  Include all coffee drinks whether hot, cold/iced, instant, shop bought (including Starbucks), machine made or made by hand. Coffee substitutes such as Barley Cup and Dandelion Coffee should not be recorded here. Instead, record this under other non-alcoholic drinks (further down the page). If some of your coffees were decaffeinated and some were not, please choose Varied for the decaf question. Likewise, if you added sugar/sweetener to some of your coffees but not all, or if the amount of sugar/sweetener you added varied from one coffee drink to another, please choose Varied. The questions on milk, decaffeinated coffee and sugar/sweetener need to be answered here.
category: Online follow-up > Diet by 24-hour recall > Hot/cold beverages yesterday

description_more: Question asked: "Did you add milk, cream or whitener (e.g. Coffee-mate) to your instant coffee?" This question was only asked to participants who reported drinking instant coffee yesterday.
